subject.title: Silverado-Modjeska Recreation and Park District Board

text: I sat on the SMRPD Board for 10 years in the late 90’s and early 2,000’s. I am interested in returning to the board as a Director to help the district to secure a more dependable revenue source; so that the district can remain viable and continue to provide parks and recreation services to our community.

statement.disclaimer: Statements are volunteered by the candidates and have not been checked for accuracy by any official agency.
